resources.string: Start while this screen is open. Stop here or from the recording notification.
Microphone audio is supported provisionally. The other side may be missing or faint. WACR never switches your speaker or audio route. Record only with the consent you need.
Microphone access captures audio. Notifications keep recording status and Stop visible. Audio and metadata stay encrypted on this device; this app has no network access.
Native settings checked. Actual capture must still be tested on your phone.
Microphone and notification access are required. No recording started. Review permissions below before trying again.
This settings screen could not be opened. Open Android Settings and review WACR app permissions.
Setup or storage status could not be read. Check diagnostics and try reopening the app.
Needed to record microphone audio. Record now requests native permissions; app settings can restore access after a denial.
Needed for a visible recording indicator and Stop control. Recording is refused when notification delivery is blocked.
Automatic call adapters are not available in this build. You can still start and stop manually with the required permissions.
Recognizes WhatsApp call controls, not chat messages. Sideloaded apps may first need App info: Allow restricted settings.
Corroborates WhatsApp call state. Other apps and unrelated notification text are not retained.
Allow background operation for reliable detection. On Samsung, also review Background usage limits and Never sleeping apps; Android APIs cannot verify that separate list.
Status and Stop control while recording call audio.
Checking private storage and microphone access.
Microphone audio. The other side may be missing.
Storage below 500 MB. Microphone audio; the other side may be missing.
Finalizing encrypted audio on this device.
Recording could not start or continue. Allow microphone access in Android settings.
Recording could not start or continue. Enable WACR notifications and its recording status channel.
Android blocked recording from the background. Open WACR and try again.
Microphone capture is unavailable or silenced on this device.
Recording could not start. Less than 100 MB of storage is available.
No audio was captured. No playable recording was saved.
Recording failed while reading or encrypting private audio. Recoverable files were retained.
The private recording database could not be used. Existing files were retained.
The audio encoder failed. Recoverable files were retained.
Unfinished recordings could not be safely recovered. Existing files were retained.
Native encryption or audio support is unavailable on this device.
Recording was interrupted. Encrypted audio will be checked for recovery.
The recorder could not continue. Recoverable files were retained.
Recording saved. Stopped because storage fell below 100 MB.
No recordings yet. Start one from Home.
Encrypted recordings could not be loaded. Original files are retained. Retry or review diagnostics.
Finalized audio sizes only. Active segments, metadata, logs and pending deletion files also use storage.
Playback failed. Reopen this recording to retry. Encrypted files have not been changed.
Audio is not available while recording or when recovery found no playable audio.
Playback is paused during recording to avoid competing with call audio.
